name: Call of Cthulhu: Dark Corners of the Earth

locations.note: The story includes Jack Walters's earlier Boston history and investigation.
In 1922 Jack Walters comes to the decaying fishing town of Innsmouth to find a missing grocery clerk, and has to sneak past its cultists and corrupt police to get out.

routes.name: Walters's investigation
routes.note: The game moves between Walters's Boston history and his later investigation in Innsmouth; these episodes span different years.
